idea: Plant a legitimate customer whose recurring monthly bill is charged on a newly upgraded phone after a 35-day holiday pause on a dormant card, while overriding the case pack's risk_score to 0.9999 (diverging from the transaction's 0.04 score) to induce a false alarm.
